evidenceDecision: Retired manager owners cannot publish readiness. Subscription tests independently exercise stop-before-ready, stop-during-retry, coalesced drain and callback suppression. Focused acquisition adds direct exhaustive two-socket/two-owner interest traces plus deferred read, real dispatcher, reply-send and cleanup consumers; their bounded claims and exclusions are in verification/contracts/shared-acquisition.md. Desk watches add exhaustive bounded interest traces, deferred per-holder captured-trigger/failure cases, native session fences, two-browser declaration consumers and dispatcher/cleanup tests. The actual Desk browser fixture checks shared hooks and authoritative Desk refresh; bounds and excluded claims are in verification/contracts/shared-acquisition.md. Timer removal activates all original T2 assertions, with two-host Inspector/reference/retry consumers, deferred catalogue coalescing, failed bootstrap recovery and actual Chrome preview-removal effects. The actual service hello advertises the capability. See verification/contracts/shared-acquisition.md for bounds and excluded liveness claims. The composed acceptance now runs createWorldService with two synthetic hosts, a real Bridge/store Worker and a second real WebSocket, checking the parity outputs, shared native acquisition, notices, Desk references and retirement in flight; original T2 bodies/harnesses remain unchanged. Current specs include both complete shared-acquisition deltas.
